metadata.description: Colophon — living, in-repo design systems for GitHub Copilot.

plugins.name: colophon
plugins.description: Seeds DESIGN.md and an AGENTS.md pointer, edits and previews design tokens and companion component patterns in a Copilot canvas, and guides agents from design rationale to production UI. Existing .agents/design/ JSON systems remain supported, with configurable port targets and resource mappings.
